description: Phase 3 sweep S7 (E12): QSTL (paper HEA, 3 context + 1 prediction qubit) trained with the QBGU superposed loss (Eq. 20) versus per-sample SGD on one window per SPSA iteration (Eq. 18-19), at equal total shots (6e7 per asset): 3000 iterations x 10,000 shots and 300,000 iterations x 100 shots for each objective. Raw and MA5 data; classical baselines rerun as reference. Evaluation matrix: no winner selected.

evaluation.split: test = chronological last 20 % of T+1 windows
evaluation.checkpoint: final iteration for quantum models; validation-selected refit for baselines
evaluation.aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation over seeds; paired-by-seed differences with a 95 % t interval
evaluation.tie_rule: a paired difference whose 95 % interval contains 0 is reported as not distinguishable
evaluation.selection_rule: none: evaluation matrix; QBGU and per-sample are compared at equal (iterations, shots)
